content.comment_body: Hi, I've been using [product_name] V7.0.30 with Windows 7 and 8 for more than a year along with [product_name] [article_no]. Today, I received new [product_name] hardware, and when I try to transfer data between the PC and the module, I encounter an error: "YOU NEED A NEWER VERSION OF THIS SOFTWARE". The website doesn't offer a new version. I also tried on Ubuntu but got the same message. Does anyone know what the issue might be? Thanks.
Hello, You need to upgrade to [product_name] v7.1.5. [url] After that, you can work with [product_name] [article_no] ES5. Best regards,

Hello, The [article_no] now has updated firmware (ES5). Update [product_name] via Help > Update Center, or download the update from [url]. The latest version is 7.1.5. After updating, select ES5 in your hardware settings and try again. Regards,

Thanks [user_name] and [user_name], but I downloaded the files from the website and it's still version 7.0.30 on both Windows and Linux. I checked under Help > Update, but only language files are available. Thanks again.
Hello, Maybe this link will help: how do you install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name] software with or without the original installation? [url] Best regards,

Thanks again [user_name], I've found the issue. The full version download is 7.0.30, but the upgrade version is 7.1. However, since I'm using the demo, I can't update. Is there a way to install the upgrade without a DVD? Thanks.

Hi, Yes, it's possible to upgrade without using a CD/DVD. Open [product_name], go to Help > Update Center (make sure you have admin rights), and follow the instructions. This process requires an installed full version of [product_name]. If you are using the demo, it won't work. For the demo in the new version, simply download it again. Hope this helps.
Ok, thanks, I will consider possible options.

Hi, I just downloaded the latest demo version V7.0.30 from the website, and when I use the tool ("Transfer/download data archive"), I still get the message: "You need a newer version of this software." Is there a new demo version available, and where can I download it? Thanks in advance,

Hello, Please note: You cannot transfer or upload/download circuit programs to/from a [product_name] using a programming cable—you also can't do online monitoring or program testing unless you have the full version of the software. These functions are restricted in the demo. Regards,
A new question has been posted regarding when [product_name] will be available for Windows 8.
A new question from [user_name] has been split into a separate thread titled '[product_name] V7.0.30 upgrade to v7.1.5'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users attempting to use [product_name] V7.0.30 (demo version) with new [product_name] hardware are blocked by a message requesting a newer software version. Several users experience confusion when only the older demo version is available and key features like program transfer and monitoring are disabled in demo mode. This demonstrates strict limitations tied to licensing and software updates, causing frustration and productivity issues when updates needed for new hardware are inaccessible to demo users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the demo version of [product_name] to support newer hardware or to allow easy upgrades, and hope to transfer programs and data without having to purchase the full version or use physical installation media.
